models.title: Camel
models.description: A detailed 3D model of a camel, a large herbivorous mammal adapted to desert environments. Known for their ability to store water and nutrients in their humps.

models.title: Cow
models.description: A 3D model of a domestic cow, a large domesticated bovine mammal. Cows are herbivores and have been important to human agriculture for thousands of years.

models.title: Woolly Mammoth
models.description: A woolly mammoth (Mammuthus primigenius), an extinct relative of modern elephants that roamed the Earth during the Ice Age. These massive creatures went extinct approximately 4,000 years ago.

models.title: Woolly Mammoth Tooth (Upper Paleolithic)
models.description: A genuine woolly mammoth tooth specimen (NHMW-GEO-1896/0054/0001) from the Upper Paleolithic period, approximately 30,000 years ago. This fossil provides evidence of mammoth existence and evolution.

models.title: Low-poly Tyrannosaurus Rex
models.description: A low-polygon 3D model of a Tyrannosaurus Rex, one of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs ever discovered. This iconic predator roamed North America during the late Cretaceous period.

models.title: T-Rex from Turok
models.description: An animated T-Rex model with multiple animations, inspired by the Turok video game series. Demonstrates how dinosaurs were recreated for entertainment media.

models.title: Apollo 11 Command Module Columbia
models.description: The Apollo 11 Command Module Columbia, the spacecraft that carried Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins to the Moon in 1969. This is a high-resolution scan of the actual historical spacecraft.

models.title: Eiffel Tower
models.description: A detailed 3D model of the Eiffel Tower, the iconic iron lattice tower located in Paris, France. Built in 1889, it has become one of the world's most recognizable landmarks.

models.title: Statue of Liberty
models.description: A 3D model of the Statue of Liberty, a colossal copper statue depicting Libertas, the Roman goddess of liberty. Located on Liberty Island in New York Harbor, it was a gift from France to the United States.

models.title: Apollo Lunar Module
models.description: The Apollo Lunar Module (LM), the spacecraft designed to land astronauts on the Moon and return them to orbit. This module was crucial for the success of the Apollo missions.

models.title: Tyrannosaurus Rex Skeleton (Museum Quality)
models.description: A museum-quality 3D scan of an actual T-Rex skeleton from the Smithsonian collections. This is scientific data captured from real fossils, showing the accurate anatomy of this prehistoric predator.

models.title: Ancient Egyptian Pottery
models.description: A 3D model of ancient Egyptian pottery from historical records. Egyptian pottery dates back thousands of years and shows the craftsmanship of ancient civilizations.

models.title: Ancient Egyptian Vase (Museum Scan)
models.description: A scanned 3D model of an ancient Egyptian vase. This vessel represents the artistic and functional pottery that was created by Egyptian artisans thousands of years ago.

models.title: Egyptian Artifacts Collection
models.description: A collection of authentic Egyptian artifacts digitized from the British Museum's holdings. These objects span thousands of years of Egyptian civilization.

models.title: Ancient Egypt Pack
models.description: A comprehensive collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts and objects, digitally recreated for educational purposes. Includes replicas of items from Egyptian temples and museums worldwide.

models.title: Mammuthus Primigenius (Woolly Mammoth)
models.description: A Woolly Mammoth (Mammuthus primigenius) from the Smithsonian's natural history collection. This species lived during the Pleistocene epoch and went extinct at the end of the last Ice Age.

models.title: Sabu Disc (Ancient Egyptian Artifact)
models.description: A replica of the Sabu Disc, an ancient Egyptian stone artifact made from meteoritic iron. Dating to the 1st Dynasty (circa 3000 BCE), it is one of the oldest iron objects ever made.
